scope: Four related native queries, two audit seeds each. Resident single-slot service, serial GPU inference inside logical batches; no general batching or significance claim. Reference/startup/warmup are separate; actual paid labels drive all policies. Audit-beyond-inference includes sampling, inversion and its bookkeeping; projection is not added twice.
